nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## Idol: one image to a 3D Gaussian splat

**First run** downloads about 6.6 GB into `ComfyUI/models/idol/` (Idol, DINOv3, FLUX.2 VAE). No Hugging Face account is needed for the automatic path.

### Manual download (if auto fails)

Create the folders, then put each file at the path on the right. URLs are Hugging Face `resolve` links (right-click → Save as, or any downloader).

**1. Idol (~2.9 GB)** → `models/idol/speridlabs_idol/`

| File | URL |
|---|---|
| `config.json` | https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol/resolve/main/config.json |
| `denoiser.safetensors` | https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol/resolve/main/denoiser.safetensors |
| `decoder.safetensors` | https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol/resolve/main/decoder.safetensors |
| `decoder_gs.safetensors` | https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol/resolve/main/decoder_gs.safetensors |
| `birefnet.safetensors` | https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol/resolve/main/birefnet.safetensors |

**2. FLUX.2 VAE (~0.2 GB)** → `models/idol/encoders/flux2-vae/vae/`

| File | URL |
|---|---|
| `config.json` | https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B/resolve/main/vae/config.json |
| `diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors` | https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B/resolve/main/vae/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors |

**3. DINOv3 ViT-H+ (~3.4 GB)** → `models/idol/encoders/dinov3-vith16plus/`

Drop-in files must be the **transformers** layout (what Meta ships). The automatic download uses the ungated [timm](https://huggingface.co/timm/vit_huge_plus_patch16_dinov3.lvd1689m) copy and renames it once; a raw timm `model.safetensors` is **not** drop-in.

Preferred manual path (same weights; gated — accept terms + `hf auth login` if the links 401):

| File | URL |
|---|---|
| `config.json` | https://huggingface.co/facebook/dinov3-vith16plus-pretrain-lvd1689m/resolve/main/config.json |
| `model.safetensors` | https://huggingface.co/facebook/dinov3-vith16plus-pretrain-lvd1689m/resolve/main/model.safetensors |
| `LICENSE.md` (optional) | https://huggingface.co/facebook/dinov3-vith16plus-pretrain-lvd1689m/resolve/main/LICENSE.md |

Leave `dinov3_source` and `flux2_vae_source` empty so the loader uses these folders. In the Idol Model Loader, keep weights on `speridlabs/idol (auto-download)` (or pick a local folder that already has Idol's five files).

### Input image
- PNG with transparency: keep the `MASK` link. `invert_mask` is on by default because Load Image stores alpha inverted. Turn it off for masks with 1 = object (most background-removal nodes).
- JPG or an image without alpha: delete the `MASK` link (or leave it, an empty mask is ignored). BiRefNet removes the background.

**preset**: lowest / low / medium / high / ultra set steps and num_gaussians (medium = reference). Editing those values switches it to custom.

**mode**: `synthetic` for renders and generated images, `real` for photos.

**num_gaussians**: 32,768 to 1,048,576. More is sharper and slower to view.

**fast_sampling**: batched CFG + cuDNN attention. Turn it off if VRAM is low.

**Output**: the `.ply` goes to `output/idol/`. Preview Splat shows it in the graph. Connect `model_3d` to *Get Splat* for the other core splat nodes (render, transform, splat to mesh).
